sources.title: Xayah Build Guide: ✔️ How to use Feathers

passive.name: Clean Cuts
passive.text: After using an ability, Xayah's next basic attacks will hit all targets along their path and leave a Feather.

spells.name: Double Daggers
spells.text: Xayah throws two damaging daggers that also drop Feathers she can recall.

spells.name: Deadly Plumage
spells.text: Xayah creates a storm of blades that increase her Attack Speed and damage while also granting her Move Speed if she attacks a champion.

spells.name: Bladecaller
spells.text: Xayah calls back all her dropped Feathers dealing damage and rooting enemies.

spells.name: Featherstorm
spells.text: Xayah leaps into the air becoming untargetable and throwing out a fan of daggers, dropping Feathers she can recall.

archetype.value: Xayah is a marksman who plays around her feathers.

axis.value: Xayah can poke with Double Daggers, then recall the Feathers it drops with Bladecaller.

spikes.at: Bladecaller’s cooldown falls from 12 to 8 seconds
spikes.why: Xayah can recall Feathers more often for damage and roots.

bait.why: After Xayah uses Double Daggers, its cooldown is a window before she can throw those two Feather-dropping daggers again.
After Xayah uses Deadly Plumage, its cooldown is a window before she can gain its Attack Speed and damage again.
After Xayah uses Featherstorm, its cooldown is a window before she can become untargetable with it again.
